A pity this extension did not get an update in over two years. The icons and their colors are cute, superbly readable and make navigation a breeze and fun. However, the extension is not able to recognize any tab groups. Further, while I appreciate the layout (actually core to my intended workflow), there should be an option for larger thumbnails or full-length tab titles (and/or URLs), not only one single icon view. Last but not least the navigation buttons (or settings) for each window should possibly be either (a) smaller or (b) hidden / toggle-able if the user decides so. Right now they take up too much real estate in the small flyout popup of Tab Manager Plus.

It suddently switched the Save Tabs for Later feature off and deleted all my saved tabs. What was the point of this when you suddenly decide to mark this as experimental and turn it off, causing me to lose all those saved tabs?
reviews.dev_reply: Hi, this option was always marked "experimental", and is disabled by default because of exactly this reason. I didn't want people to lose their data because of some random issue. In your case it sounds like the extension lost all its settings, and was reset to default. I am not sure why it happened - maybe the hard drive was full or some other chrome update issue. But that's the reason this feature is marked experimental, and always has been.

2025 Update: Still love it, but now that I've donated…

I REALLY need a better way to manage saved windows:

- Make them collapsible, so only the name shows;
- Make it easy to sort them
- Stop the names from vanishing! If I quit Chrome and return, sometimes if I just go away to another app, the window names are lost. So I end up with multiple copies of each workspace, and waste even more time choosing which saved window to open.
- Let me search for tabs in closed windows, too, so I can find the window I opened Canva in without remembering the name I gave it.

I absolutely promise a $25 donation when those things happen.

reviews.text:
I used this for years in multiple browsers. It works in Vivaldi! 

Some years ago it stopped working properly with the HUGE (over a thousand) number of tabs i have open much of the time. I couldn't switch tabs the first time using TMP. I had to do it twice.

It just updated to all-new version 7, and I have 876 tabs open, and working for switching tabs the first time, so i'm hopeful it will work with 1400 tabs. Vivalidi starts crapping out at that point. TMP lets you toggle selecting tabs using right click, which is super fast if you need to pick them one my one, and then you can drag to another window in the list view, or move them to a window or delete them with one click. It's better for tab management that Vivaldi's native tab manager , even with the fairly recent big improvements.

Precisely what I was looking for as a replacement for Cluster

- You can easily see all your tabs at a glance in a pop up window or its own dedicated tab
- Search for key words to bring up specific tabs/find what you'r looking for quickly
- Reorder/drag drop/color code/rename to keep your window/tab groupings in order
- Clean UI
- Customize your shortcut to bring up the tab manager

Perfection, I feel 10x more productive with this!

You are the one and only add-on that I felt I NEED TO give a complement, one day I will donate u some coffee for sure.
